Package game.positions.farm

Class Puddle

java.lang.Object
edu.monash.fit2099.engine.GameEntity
edu.monash.fit2099.engine.positions.Ground
game.positions.farm.Puddle
All Implemented Interfaces:
Printable, Chargeable
public class Puddle extends Ground implements Chargeable
A puddle on the ground. It starts uncharged and can become a charged puddle when a CopperNode is broken nearby. A charged puddle shocks whoever stands on it every turn.
